How This Protection Works

1. Domain Locking The license key is strictly tied to this authorized domain (and subdomains). Execution is instantly locked on unauthorized hosts.
2. Tamper-Proof Cryptography Protected by HMAC-SHA256 signatures. Any manual database tampering or expiry alteration immediately revokes system access.
